sermon.title: Jesus' Job Description 07/30/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Continuing what God said about Jesus, Pastor David G. Kincer teaches Isaiah 52:13–53:2 as Jesus’ job description: the Servant exalted, yet marred more than any man. The arm of the Lord will be bared before all nations, and he argues Jesus will reveal the marred, post-crucified Christ—the Lamb that was slain—to every nation before his return.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “Matthew 53” spoken for Isaiah 53; rapture picture “typical from 1830”; nations unknown until “the late 1700s”; “two and a half million” Israelites; Jesus appearing “seven times” after ascension and “12 times” after resurrection; the servant seeing chariots (2 Kings 6, Elisha) attributed garbled. Sensitive content kept as spoken: “these Indians and these barbarians” skinning prisoners; a bloodied boxer image; “oneness people” corrected.
